proposal.hypothesis: The baseline prompt's 'changes no tools and no protocol' framing is read as a permission boundary, suppressing harness-supplied task tools; explicitly authorizing tool use unblocks tool-dependent terminal-bench trials.
proposal.expectedBehaviorChange: Solve-mode prompt now explicitly authorizes use of all harness-provided tools and files while scoping the no-change statement to the candidate plugin itself.

mechanismAssertions: In solve mode the candidate registers exactly one section named candidate:identity.
In propose mode the candidate registers exactly one section named candidate:proposal-policy.
preservationAssertions: Disposing the candidate fiber removes the registered section and restores the pre-boot inventory exactly.
